name: exec_background
title: Start a program and return its process id.

origin.description: Start a program and return its process id.
origin.details: Start a program and return its process id.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(sys))
pid <- exec_background("true", std_out = FALSE, std_err = FALSE); Sys.sleep(0.05); cat(exec_status(pid, wait = TRUE), "\n")

translation.description: Start a program and return its process id.
translation.details: Start a program and return its process id.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
import time
from r_sys import exec_background, exec_status
pid = exec_background("true", std_out=False, std_err=False)
time.sleep(0.05)
print(exec_status(pid, wait=True))
